newsitem.title: UK: LSE seens AIM companies benefiting from budget.
newsitem.headline: LSE seens AIM companies benefiting from budget.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange said it expects companies listed on its Alternative Investment Market to benefit from the annual budget.
The Chancellor's move to relax Capital Gains Tax Relief rules means relief will be available to companies with overseas subsidiaries, the exchange said in a statement.

Under existing rules, companies with foreign operations do not qualify for relief. They will now qualify if they carry out a qualifying trade and the majority of their business is wholly or mainly in the UK.
The move also means eligibility for relief will depend upon the activities of a group as a whole, and not on each individual group's activities, the exchange said.
